text:
ITEM 1 | Large pale-orange fillet pieces with flaky, moist-looking texture and light browning on edges, a few small green herb flecks and bits of seasoning scattered on top, sitting in the center-right of the plate; roughly 8 cm long by 5 cm wide, about 2.5 cm thick, slightly glossy | 150
ITEM 2 | Grey-silver skin-on fish portion with pinkish flesh at the lower-left edge, matte skin with a faint sheen, partially covered by greens and seeds; roughly 6 cm by 4 cm, about 1.5 cm thick | 80
ITEM 3 | Dark green fresh spinach leaves, glossy and wilted in places, with small red pepper pieces and dark seeds mixed in, covering the left side of the plate; about 12 cm by 9 cm spread, thin layer about 0.5 cm high | 70
ITEM 4 | Small scattered tan-brown grain or lentil-like granules with a slightly moist surface, mixed among the greens and fish, sparse coverage; about 3 cm total spread | 15
ITEM 5 | Small diced red pepper pieces, glossy red-orange with slightly charred edges, scattered among the spinach and fish; each piece about 1 cm | 10
ITEM 6 | Pale yellow pineapple chunks with cut edges and slightly translucent surface, cubed about 2 cm per side, clustered on the right side of the plate; moist, firm | 110
ITEM 7 | Shredded cabbage slaw with thin orange carrot strands and white shredded cabbage, moist with a light sheen, mounded at top-right of the plate; about 7 cm by 5 cm, 2 cm high | 50
